newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: National Bank Bahrain plans Islamic fund.
newsitem.headline: National Bank Bahrain plans Islamic fund.

text.p: National Bank of Bahrain (NBB) said on Monday it would launch a new Islamic investment fund next week which would operate in accordance with Islamic law.
Bahrain's largest commercial bank said in a statement the five-year al-Watani Fund for Islamic Investment would be offered to investors in Gulf Arab states from May 24 for six weeks.
The minimum investment in the fund will be $10,000, priced at $100 per share. Moslems and non-Moslems can invest.
"Strict adherence to Islamic sharia, strong performance potential and reduced risk were key objectives in setting up the new fund," NBB general manager Abdul-Razak Hassan said.

The fund, the first to be launched by a Bahraini commercial bank, will initially invest in a portfolio of global equities managed by Wellington Management Company, an independent investment adviser in the United States, the statement said.
